children: IndusInd Bank Ltd. (NSE:INDUSINDBK) posted a Q2FY27 PAT of Rs12.4bn with rising core PPOP, improving margins and asset quality, plans to refocus on secured retail/MSME lending and fee income to lift RoA by FY27, while mixed broker views and new fees accompanied a ~2% stock uptick.
: IndusInd Bank (INDUSINDBK) Q2FY27: PAT Rs12.4bn; core PPOP ~Rs2,510cr (+30% YoY); NII ~Rs45.7bn; NIM ~3.23%; gross slippages ~1.7%; GNPA/NNPA 2.73%/0.83%; deposits +10%, advances +11%.
: IndusInd Bank (INDUSINDBK) plans to align loan growth with industry, focus on secured retail and MSME lending, and target improved profitability via margin and fee income to boost RoA by FY27.
: Brokerages gave mixed post-results views on IndusInd Bank (INDUSINDBK): Nuvama cut target to Rs 1,200 (Buy), Motilal Oswal target Rs 1,050 (Neutral), Systematix target Rs 950 (Hold).
: IndusInd Bank (INDUSINDBK) will charge fees from Nov 1, 2026: declined POS Rs25, failed ATM withdrawal Rs25, and non-financial cheque return Rs50 (GST extra) for specified savings accounts.
: IndusInd Bank (INDUSINDBK) shares rose about 2%, opening near Rs 835 and trading around Rs 852 intraday after the bank reported quarterly profit recovery and improving metrics.
